jin_size.description: Allows the model to update the collapsed JIN runtime avatar size for the current live session.
rules: Use to set JIN size (or weight)! Change live JIN avatar size in pixels.
Emit marker using exactly this schema <JIN_SIZE> 120px 120px </JIN_SIZE>
Put only the size payload inside the tag body; do not put it in the opening tag.
The first number is width and the second number is height.
You may emit <JIN_SIZE> 120px </JIN_SIZE> to make the avatar square.
Payload values may include px or omit px.
Labeled payload values are also valid, for example <JIN_SIZE> w:120px h:120px </JIN_SIZE>, <JIN_SIZE> w:120 </JIN_SIZE>, or <JIN_SIZE> h:120 </JIN_SIZE>.
